# Slack Modal Build Progress

## Builder 11 [DONE]

**Branch:** `builder-11-cancel`
**Base:** `feature/slack-modal` @ `14cbc9b`
**Scope:** `view_closed` cancellation handler + concurrency soft-warn + `notify_on_close` on team-member view.

### What shipped

1. **`view_closed` handler** wired in `src/app/api/slack/interactivity/route.ts`:
   - Resolves proposal via `private_metadata.proposalId`
   - Idempotent: no-op when proposal is missing or in any terminal status (`submitted` / `cancelled` / `expired` / `failed`)
   - Flips proposal to `status='cancelled'`, `statusReason='user-dismissed'`
   - Fires `recordProposalLifecycleTransition('proposal_cancelled', ...)` lifecycle counter
   - Posts `MODAL_CANCELLED_THREAD_REPLY` Civ-voice copy via `chat.postMessage` to `proposal.channelId` with `thread_ts` when available (best-effort - logs but doesn't fail on Slack errors)
   - Always returns HTTP 200

2. **Concurrency soft-warn** added at `src/lib/slack/modals/concurrency-check.ts`:
   - `checkConcurrentProposal({ toolName, fuzzyTitle, currentUserSlackId, currentChannelId })`
   - Pulls `bot_modal_proposals` peers (status=pending, same channel, same toolName, different user, createdAt > now-60s)
   - Re-applies filters in JS for hermeticity against test stubs
   - Runs `fuzzyMatchCandidates` (Sørensen-Dice, threshold 0.6) against args.title (tasks) / args.name (projects) / args.fullName (team-members)
   - Returns `{hasConcurrent: false}` or `{hasConcurrent: true, otherUser, otherTitle, createdAt}`

3. **Wire-in:** Concurrency check fires in `handleOpenCreateModal` only on `proposal.kind === 'create'`. **Integration approach: concatenation into `multiMatchHint`** (NOT a new view-builder param) - prepends the soft-warn to the existing hint string (or replaces undefined) so all three view builders pick it up via existing rendering plumbing without signature changes. Single rendering surface, no invasive cross-file changes.

4. **`notify_on_close: true`** added to `team-member.ts` view builder (single line). `task.ts` and `project.ts` already had it from earlier waves.

5. **Copy strings** added to `src/lib/slack/modals/copy.ts`:
   - `MODAL_CANCELLED_THREAD_REPLY` constant
   - `CONCURRENT_PROPOSAL_SOFT_WARN(otherUser, otherTitle)` formatter
   - Both pass copy.test.ts em-dash + en-dash + L1/L2 grep guards.

### Tests

- 5 new copy.test.ts assertions (Wave 11 strings + grep guards)
- 13 new concurrency-check.test.ts cases (no candidates / same-user excluded / fuzzy-matched / >60s window / different channel / different toolName / sub-threshold / project-name field / team-member-fullName field / empty title / malformed args / non-pending status / case-insensitive)
- 5 new route.test.ts assertions for view_closed (happy path / already-cancelled idempotent / already-submitted idempotent / missing proposal / missing private_metadata)
- 4 new route.test.ts assertions for concurrency wire-in (call signature / soft-warn into multiMatchHint / no-op when hasConcurrent=false / not called for edit-flow)
- 2 new team-member.test.ts assertions (notify_on_close on create + edit)

**Net new tests: 29.** Final suite: **2707 passed / 19 skipped / 0 failed** (baseline 2678 → 2707; within spec target 2693-2710).

### Verification

- `pnpm test:run` -> 137 test files passed, 1 skipped, 2707 tests passed, 19 skipped, 0 failed
- `pnpm lint` -> 0 errors, 10 warnings (all pre-existing; unchanged by Builder 11)
- Civ voice grep guard: copy.test.ts source-level scan passes for em-dash (U+2014), en-dash (U+2013), and L1/L2 tokens.

### Commit

Will be appended after `git commit`.
